title: Policy-bound causally closed CMIX midpoint ceiling oracle
hypothesis: A causally closed, tape-isolated local-32 Byte-LSTM update can preserve exact P/K identity and produce target-scale finite-archive gain over both the qualified q1 parent and a frozen 16-event target-rotation control.
promotion_condition: At 250KB, a fresh-replayed v3 parent qualification, complete source and control closure, exact P/K identity, complete P/K/F/S roundtrips, deterministic repeats, strict F-over-P and F-over-S archive ordering, package closure, and resource compliance authorize only a separately bound 1MB calibration; a valid 1MB gain of at least 4,080 bytes authorizes only 10MB.
kill_condition: Authority, implementation, dependency, inverse, repeat, package, or resource failure yields no scientific verdict and at most one correction-only successor. Retire CMIX midpoint adaptation if a valid 1MB F gain is below 4,080 bytes, a valid 10MB F gain is below 40,793 bytes, or F does not strictly beat S.
activation_effect: A passing activation authorizes only a new content-addressed source materialization and static closure gate from the sealed q1 parent; it grants no archive execution or scientific result by itself.
supersession_scope: Qualification authority only; every v3 scientific and numeric semantic remains frozen.
interfaces_exposed: P/K/F/S finite-archive oracle with byte-32 causal closure, byte-33 first effect, native-tape isolation, exact replay witnesses, and policy-bound q1 parent authority
retired_neighborhoods: Supersedes only the unexecuted policy-v4-bound v3 authority route; no optimizer, rank, scale, parameter subset, horizon, predictor family, population, or threshold retry.
